verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents creating Linear tickets to fix the root cause from downtime using AI-based suggestions, and generating automated post-mortems from the incident timeline and Slack. That covers pushing follow-up work into an issue tracker. Nothing in the pack shows follow-up actions being tracked to completion, or ticket status syncing back to the incident or postmortem. Missing for 10: follow-up action item tracking through to completion, bidirectional status sync with the issue tracker, documented support for trackers beyond Linear (e.g. Jira), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
